The drink machine can be used for production, and production can start at level 0.
Formulas for the drink machine:

[list=1]
[*]Iced black tea maker: 2 copper ingots + 1 iron ingot + 1 battery pack + 1 unit of tea leaves
[*]Lucky coffee maker: 2 refined quartz + 2 iron ingots + 1 battery pack + 1 unit of coffee beans
[*]Coca - Cola maker: 3 refined quartz + 1 iron ingot + 1 battery pack + 1 unit of Jajo Cola
[/list]
Drink buffs:

[list=1]
[*]Iced black tea: +2 to speed
[*]Lucky coffee: +1 to luck, +1 to speed
[*]Coca - Cola: +1 to attack, +1 to speed
[/list]
